reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage BUSD as an earning platform requiring a 10 BUSD registration payment, with the payment divided between X3 and X4 slots. It links matrix or upline positions and team-building to claims of doubled investments, eleven-times income, and rapid earnings. The presentation cites participant earnings and wallet-payment descriptions to reinforce the participation-and-return structure.

citations.quote: BEST EARNING PLATFORM FROM *_FORSAGE BUSD_*
As soon as you register here, you need 10 BUSD for your registration. You need 10 BUSD for your registration. Out of which 5 BUSD goes into X3 and 5 BUSD goes into X4.
i am saying that you have to make team if you want to achieve good income

opening.argument: The presentation does not describe an unconditional or risk-free return. It distinguishes stable from unstable currencies, explains that prices can change, and acknowledges that complete transparency is impossible. It also warns that failing to receive a payment can create a significant loss. Those qualifications matter: the speaker is describing conditions and risks within a crypto system, not stating that every viewer is guaranteed profit. The discussion of possible outcomes is therefore better read as conditional financial commentary than as a categorical promise.

citations.quote: 100% transparency is not possible. 100% belief cannot be done.
Unstable means whose value is 10 rupees today, tomorrow night it may be 1000 also.
If you have not taken the payment, then it is a very big loss for this

rebuttal.rebuttal: The registration amount and matrix descriptions establish how the program is presented, but they do not by themselves establish deception. The presentation also discloses the amount, its allocation, additional gas fees, and the possibility of loss. The reference argument treats earnings language as a guarantee while omitting the speaker's explicit qualifications about volatility and transparency.

citations.quote: you will have to leave 2 or 3 dollars extra for gas fees
Unstable means whose value is 10 rupees today, tomorrow night it may be 1000 also.
100% transparency is not possible.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualifications do not neutralize the core solicitation. The speaker tells viewers that registration requires payment, describes earnings as available through team formation, and presents repeated return multiples. A warning that losses are possible can coexist with a recruitment-based earning pitch; it does not make the pitch ordinary commentary.

you have to make team if you want to achieve good income
so you get 11 time income friends

opening.argument: The video's central activity is an explanatory walkthrough of cryptocurrency, blockchain, smart contracts, and the Forsage structures. The speaker defines cryptocurrency, explains how transaction blocks are connected, and describes how separate smart contracts operate. The slides likewise present decentralization and blockchain concepts. That makes the content plausibly educational or operational: it shows viewers how the system is said to work and how transactions can be checked, rather than merely asserting that they should send money. Promotional language does not erase the substantial technology demonstration.

citations.quote: Cryptocurrency is a kind of currency.
This is the data of the transaction, which is put in a block
You can verify any transaction of any person

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material explanatory does not change what it explains. The walkthrough is specifically about registration, slots, uplines, recycling, and earnings. Its technical vocabulary supplies credibility for a participation system; it does not show that the video is neutral teaching detached from solicitation.

citations.quote: As soon as you register here, you need 10 BUSD for your registration.
your upline, your downline, your cross line
it doubles your investment by 11 times

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical explanation is secondary to the paid earning opportunity. The speaker expressly identifies a registration payment, explains that higher income requires a team, and gives specific multiplier claims. A tutorial can still be promotional when its operational lesson is how to enter and profit from the matrix.

you have to make team if you want to achieve good income
you get 11 time income friends

opening.argument: The offering is described as a digital cryptocurrency product and a blockchain-based service, not as a disguised request for personal credentials or a physical product. The speaker says there is no physical product and identifies the digital product as cryptocurrency. The stated process uses wallet transactions and smart contracts, while the presentation says transactions can be individually verified. The supplied material does not show a request for Aadhaar, bank numbers, PAN details, or other credentials; indeed, it discusses transactions without those additional details. The evidence therefore supports an ordinary digital-service or cryptocurrency presentation, even if the viewer may reasonably question its profitability.

citations.quote: there is no physical product, there is a digital product of forces
Without any additional details. You can make the transaction.
You can verify any transaction of any person

rebuttal.rebuttal: This is not merely a product description. The disclosed service requires paid registration into X3 and X4, places participants in upline structures, and ties income to team building. Calling cryptocurrency a digital product does not remove the central participation-and-commission mechanism identified in the presentation.

citations.quote: Out of which 5 BUSD goes into X3 and 5 BUSD goes into X4.
you have to make team if you want to achieve good income
your upline, your downline, your cross line

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of credential collection is beside the point. The relevant mechanism is the money flow: viewers pay to register, positions are organized through uplines and downlines, and the speaker links team formation to income. The digital format and transaction visibility do not establish that the promised returns come from an ordinary underlying service.
